claims.statement: ecshopx-aftersales owns the aftersales lifecycle for normal orders across three tables — aftersales (header, aftersales_bn PK), aftersales_detail (per-line rows), aftersales_refund (money/point movement, refund_bn PK) — plus aftersales_offline_refund for bank-transfer records; all fee fields are fen-denominated integers, mirroring legacy PHP semantics.

The aftersales state model is dual-column: aftersales_status (0 待处理 pending, 1 处理中 accepted, 2 已处理 finished, 3 已驳回 rejected, 4 已撤销 withdrawn) plus a fine-grained progress column; the two are always written together on header and detail rows.

progress value 8 (merchant confirmed receipt of returned goods) is read by AftersalesRefundConfirmService.confirmRefund as a gate for approving Jushuitan-linked REFUND_GOODS (progress != 8 throws 卖家暂未收货) but has no Java write path in the repository — it is an inbound-only contract state set by the external Jushuitan receiving surface; likewise entity-commented progress 5 and 6 have no readers or writers.

Admin REST surface: AftersalesController at /api/v1 exposes GET /aftersales (list, pageSize capped 50), GET /aftersales/logExport, GET /aftersales/{aftersales_bn}, POST /aftersales/review, POST /aftersales/refundCheck, GET /aftersales/financial/export, GET+POST /aftersales/remind, PUT /aftersales/remark, POST /aftersales/apply, POST /aftersales/sendback; the sibling RefundController serves GET /refund, GET /refund/detail/{refund_bn}, GET /refund/logExport, GET /refund/offline/bank and POST /refund/offline.

Front wxapp surface at /api/v1/h5app: POST /wxapp/aftersales (apply), POST /wxapp/aftersales/sendback (single or batch), POST /wxapp/aftersales/close, GET /wxapp/aftersales, GET /wxapp/aftersales/info, GET /wxapp/aftersales/remind/detail; POST /wxapp/aftersales/modify is a PHP-compatibility stub returning an empty 200.

Apply splits each requested line into one-unit aftersales: AftersalesApplyShopApplyByNumService.shopApplyByNum (both the plain overload and the shareFullDeliveredAftersalesQuantity overload delegate to checkApply) resolves the order header via OrderNormalOrderHeaderReadPort (missing → 系统无此订单，无法申请售后) and the primary success trade via OrderSuccessTradeReadPort (missing → 无有效支付交易单，无法申请售后), then loops each detail row into num single-unit rows (num=1, per-row total_fee/total_point stripped) passed to shopApplyByNumHandle — which runs one TransactionTemplate per unit (insert detail + header, recompute per-unit amounts, decrement orders_normal_orders.left_aftersales_num, createRefund with status READY, order process log) and registers ordered post-commit publishing.

checkApply enforces the apply guards: order status not NOTPAY/CANCEL, DONE orders past order_auto_close_aftersales_time rejected, ziti orders must have delivery_status DONE, REFUND_GOODS/EXCHANGING_GOODS lines need delivery_item_num > 0, per-line requested quantity ≤ remaining quota (front ONLY_REFUND counts lineNum − cancelled − delivered − applied-ONLY_REFUND; return/exchange counts delivered − applied-return/exchange; the admin shareFullDeliveredAftersalesQuantity path with a fully-delivered order shares the full delivered quota), and freight only on the final full-line return capped by paid-minus-refunded cash/point freight. Top-level refund_fee/refund_point are NOT validated by checkApply — the quantity-split apply ignores them and recomputes per-unit amounts in the handle layer (AftersalesApplyShopApplyByNumHandleService.floorDivMulBd: total ÷ lineNum at scale 2 RoundingMode.DOWN × num, then FLOOR to int; the final unit absorbs the remainder as line total − already applied). Pinned by AftersalesApplyCheckApplyServiceQuantityTest, ...FreightTest and ...TopLevelRefundTest, plus AftersalesApplyShopApplyByNumServiceSplitTest.

Review (AftersalesReviewService.aftersalesReview, requires aftersales_status = 0): reject sets refund REFUSE, aftersales status 3/progress 3 with refuse_reason, restores left_aftersales_num (or partialCancelRestore for partial-cancel rows) and publishes WDT + TradeAftersales; approve ONLY_REFUND sets refund AUDIT_SUCCESS with channel offline when the trade paid offline_pay else original, aftersales status 1/progress 9, brokerage rollback per detail, and afterCommit OrderRefundComplete + Jushuitan + WDT + InvoiceRed; approve return-goods sets status 1/progress 1 (2 when return_type=offline), stamps string-typed auto_refuse_time = now + auto_refuse_time_days platform setting, and schedules AftersalesSuccessSendMsg.

refundCheck (AftersalesRefundConfirmService.refundCheck, requires aftersales_status = 1) is batch-capable: approve sets refund AUDIT_SUCCESS and aftersales status 2/progress 4 with afterCommit OrderRefundComplete + Jushuitan + Jushuitan sync Spring event + WDT + InvoiceRed, reject sets refund REFUSE and status 3/progress 3 (reject afterCommit publishes only Jushuitan + the sync event). RefundCheckOrderRefundCompletePostCommitProbeTest — a Mockito fixture with a hand-rolled PlatformTransactionManager that fires afterCommit — pins the approve-path scheduling of OrderRefundComplete (and its absence on reject, along with absent InvoiceRed/WDT), the in-tx SaaS-ERP update/cancel publish split, and the order-process-log payloads: reject uses operator_type "user" (operator_id from user_id param, 0 when absent), approve uses operator_type "admin" preferring the aftersales row's user_id, with refunds_memo/refund_memo normalization.

Sendback (admin and wxapp) rejects ONLY_REFUND and requires progress 1; the transaction sets progress 2 on header + details and stores sendback_data JSON, and afterCommit publishes TradeAftersalesLogi first (the reloaded admin/member aggregate), then the Jushuitan bus payload + JushuitanTradeAftersalesSyncSpringEvent + WDT, then the wait-confirm notice job — publisher ordering asserted by MerchantSendbackWaitConfirmNoticePostCommitProbeTest.

Close (consumer wxapp and the done-aftersales cron share executeCloseAftersalesTransaction) guards statuses 4/3/1/2/5 as uncloseable; the transaction sets status 4/progress 7 on header + details, refund CANCEL, restores left_aftersales_num, writes a process log, and afterCommit publishes TradeAftersalesCancelSpringEvent, the TradeAftersalesCancel bus event, the SaaS-ERP cancel event, the Jushuitan payload + sync event, and the cancel-notice job.

Partial cancel: orders' AdminNormalOrderPartialCancelService calls AftersalesShopPartialCancelCreateService.createForShopPartialCancel — a REQUIRES_NEW transaction creating one ONLY_REFUND aftersales flagged is_partial_cancel with floor-based fee/point split and refund READY — then optionally autoApproveOnlyRefund (gated on the platform auto_aftersales setting), which sets refund AUDIT_SUCCESS and aftersales status 1/progress 9 with afterCommit OrderRefundComplete + InvoiceRed + Jushuitan.

The schedule-refund cron (ScheduleRefundHandler @XxlJob("schedule-refund"), publishing CronAlertEvent on failure) calls AftersalesRefundService.scheduleRefund, which selects refund_status = AUDIT_SUCCESS rows with create_time ≥ 1607616000 and dispatches each as job:15:AftersalesBundle\Jobs\RefundJob with ASYNC/REDIS/slow queue — 0s delay for the first refund of an order, 60×n+1 seconds for repeats of the same order within the run.

AftersalesRefundJobService.handle reloads the refund by refund_bn + company_id and requires AUDIT_SUCCESS: offline_pay rows are skipped entirely; rows without aftersales_bn (pre-sale/order-cancel refunds) run doOnlineRefund plus a bargain rollback when the trade source is bargain; otherwise an order pay_type hint may patch the channel to offline (then only updateRefundToSuccess runs, no channel call) or original (doOnlineRefund), and updateAftersaleFinished always finishes the aftersales at status 2/progress 4.

The actual money movement is ecshopx-orders' AftersalesRefundDoRefundService.doRefund (reached via the ecshopx-common AftersalesRefundOnlineRefundPort): it requires a SUCCESS trade, short-circuits prepaid_point and zero-fee refunds to instant success, throws 0元订单不支持退款 for localpay, generates hf_order_id for hfpay when missing, records channel FAIL outcomes/exceptions into refund-error logs (re-runnable via /api/v1/trade/refunderrorlogs), sets refund SUCCESS + refunded_fee/refunded_point/refund_success_time on SUCCESS/PROCESSING else CHANGE, allocates refunded_fee proportionally across order items, and publishes TradeRefundFinish on every path plus TradeRefundStatistics and TradeRefundSpringEvent on success.

OrdersRefundPaymentDispatchService.dispatch pre-handles point (member point add-back), deposit (stored-value refund) and pos/offline_pay/prepaid_point (instant SUCCESS) before iterating AftersalesRefundPayChannelExecutor beans; the executors are Spring beans in their payment modules ordered Hfpay @Order(45), StandardOnlinePay @Order(50) (wxpay*/alipay*/bspay), Chinaums @Order(52), Adapay @Order(55), DoumenIntl @Order(55); the first supports() hit wins and no match throws 未知的支付方式.

OrderRefundComplete (job:19) routes to orders' NormalOrderRefundCompleteJobBusinessService which only acts when the order is WAIT_BUYER_CONFIRM or DONE and every line is delivered/cancelled/applied: it auto-confirms receipt (applyConfirmReceiptInTransaction + after-commit hooks, auto-close derived from the platform latest_aftersale_time setting) and restores coupons parsed from discount_info — but skips coupon restore when the DM-CRM point integration is open.

Offline refund (POST /api/v1/refund/offline via AftersalesOfflineRefundSaveService, @Transactional) records bank fields into aftersales_offline_refund; mixed payments (pay_type != point with refund points > 0) are routed through executeRefund so points settle online, otherwise the refund goes straight to SUCCESS with a TradeRefundStatistics publish; either way the aftersales header and details finish at status 2/progress 4.

The refuse-aftersales cron scans aftersales_detail where progress 1, type REFUND_GOODS and CAST(auto_refuse_time AS UNSIGNED) in (0, now+60), each detail in its own transaction (a failure skips only that row): header + detail → status 3/progress 3 with reason 未收到商品自动驳回, refund REFUSE, left_aftersales_num restored, wxa template and process log; done-aftersales finds status-3 aftersales older than 3 days per company and runs the shared close transaction per row.

Aftersales publishes dispatch events whose publishers are interfaces in ecshopx-common/dispatch implemented in ecshopx-bootstrap: EVENT_TRADE_AFTERSALES, EVENT_TRADE_AFTERSALES_CANCEL, EVENT_TRADE_AFTERSALES_LOGI, EVENT_TRADE_REFUND (SystemLink family) plus the Jushuitan, WDT and SaaS-ERP thirdparty events; listeners registered in bootstrap @PostConstruct configs include OME send, marketing-center push, SaaS-ERP (@Order 83 update / @Order 84 cancel, async default queue), WDT ERP sync and the Jushuitan aftersale_add caller.

Publisher bean wiring is per-event and load-bearing: TradeRefundDispatchPublisher has two impls — the @Primary TradeRefundDispatchPublisherImpl uses DispatchOptions.eventDefaults() (SYNC) while the async fan-out is only reachable via @Qualifier("tradeRefundAsyncFanOut"), which AftersalesApplyShopApplyByNumHandleService and AftersalesShopPartialCancelCreateService inject (dropping the qualifier would silently switch delivery to inline sync); for TradeAftersalesDispatchPublisher the async fan-out is itself @Primary; TradeAftersalesCancel and TradeAftersalesLogi publishers have only async impls.

The Jushuitan listener chain (SystemLinkJushuitanTradeAftersalesDispatchListener → JushuitanTradeAftersalesNotificationProcessor.handle) checks the company's Jushuitan setting, resolves the distributor-scoped JST shop id, requires an orders_rel_jushuitan link row with o_id, assembles the payload through the orders-side port and calls aftersale_add — swallowing exceptions at debug level so an ERP outage never breaks the aftersales transaction; the aftersales-side Jushuitan bus payload is a ~25-key full row snapshot while the WDT payload is only 4 keys (company_id, distributor_id, aftersales_bn, order_id).

Every aftersales flow publishes dispatch-bus messages only from TransactionSynchronization.afterCommit (or immediately when no synchronization is active), so listeners always reload persisted state; the intra-process Spring events (TradeAftersalesCancelSpringEvent, JushuitanTradeAftersalesSyncSpringEvent, WdtErpTradeAfterSaleSyncSpringEvent, SaasErpRefundSpringEvent, TradeRefundSpringEvent) are a legacy-compatibility layer alongside the bus.

Aftersales-owned dispatch jobs (names in AftersalesDispatchJobNames): job:15 RefundJob (slow queue, executed by AftersalesRefundJobHandler), job:19 OrderRefundCompleteJob (slow, AftersalesOrderRefundCompleteJobHandler), job:21 AftersalesSuccessSendMsg (wxa subscribe message on return-goods approval), plus the work-wechat notice jobs job:17/24/26; cron handlers (schedule-refund, refuse-aftersales, close-order-item-aftersales, done-aftersales) all publish CronAlertEvent on failure.

Adding a new refund payment channel requires only implementing the ecshopx-common AftersalesRefundPayChannelExecutor interface as a Spring bean in the payment module (with an @Order controlling precedence) — no changes in the orders or aftersales bundles; adding a new event listener requires a bootstrap *RegistrationConfig calling dispatchRegistry.registerEventListener, with no aftersales-side change.

Focused tests pin the post-commit and ordering semantics with Mockito probe fixtures (many using a hand-rolled transaction manager that fires afterCommit): RefundCheckOrderRefundCompletePostCommitProbeTest, MerchantSendbackWaitConfirmNoticePostCommitProbeTest, AftersalesShopPartialCancelAutoApproveOnlyRefundPostCommitJobsProbeTest and the family of *BusPublishProbeTest/*TradeRefundDispatchProbeTest classes; cron handlers are tested under the test-cron profile with Noop publishers.

AftersalesRefuseWxaNotifyService.sendByStatus maps the aftersales status/type pair to a WXA scene key — status 1 + REFUND_GOODS → WAIT_BUYER_RETURN_GOODS (fixed remark 商家已同意售后申请，请进行退货回寄处理), status 1 + ONLY_REFUND and status 2 → REFUND_SUCCESS (商家已同意退款), status 3 + REFUND_GOODS → SELLER_REFUSE_BUYER, status 3 + ONLY_REFUND → REFUND_CLOSED (remarks = refuse reason), other statuses skipped — then resolves the mini-program recipient via OrderTradeMiniProgramRecipientLookupPort, formats the fen refund amount (refund_amount falling back to refund_fee) to a two-decimal yuan string, and sends {scenes_name: "aftersalesRefuse", appid, openid, data:{order_id, refund_fee, remarks}} through the common AftersalesRefuseWxaSubscribeSendPort (impl in ecshopx-promotions) with forceFire=true, swallowing all failures at debug level; review and refundCheck call it after their decision, pinned by AftersalesRefuseWxaNotifyServiceTest.

The auto-refuse cron path sends its WXA notify through AftersalesAutoRefuseWxaTemplatePortImpl (impl of the common AftersalesAutoRefuseWxaTemplatePort), which fills refuse_reason with 未收到商品自动驳回 when missing and calls AftersalesRefuseWxaNotifyService.sendSellerRefuseBuyer — always resolving to SELLER_REFUSE_BUYER (status 3); the cron test config overrides this port with a Noop bean so XXL-Job tests never hit WeChat.
